skill.name: diagram-animation
skill.description: Animate flowcharts, architecture diagrams, and data charts for the web or video. Reveal nodes and links in order, show flow direction, or animate bars, lines, and numbers.
skill.summary: Create step-by-step diagram reveals and animated charts for web pages and videos.
skill.author: iart-ai

security_audit.summary: Two examples import unpinned GSAP code from a CDN, and the screenshot workflow can fetch and run Playwright if it is not installed locally. The remaining static matches are documentation, browser animation code, or preview steps, not shell substitution, traversal, or reconnaissance. No evidence found of prompt injection or intentional data exfiltration.

remediation.issue: Both GSAP examples load an unpinned browser dependency.
remediation.suggestion: Pin and review the dependency, then bundle it locally. Use SVG and CSS alone when the output must work offline without third-party requests.

remediation.issue: The screenshot command can download and execute an unpinned Playwright package.
remediation.suggestion: Run only the project-local Playwright binary from a lockfile-pinned install. Ask before installing dependencies, or verify frames manually in a browser.

remediation.issue: The standalone HTML instructions call screenshot helpers packaged, but the helpers are absent from this revision.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the packaged-helper claim and document manual capture or capture with a trusted, locally installed Playwright.

content.value_statement: Static diagrams and charts can make it difficult to see what happens first or where to look next. Guide readers through the important steps with timed reveals, moving connectors, and animated values.
actual_capabilities: Reveal diagram nodes, connectors, and labels in stages while highlighting the active path.
Show flow direction with moving dashes or a dot that follows a connector.
Grow bars from their baseline, draw line charts, and count up to exact values.
Build browser animations with SVG, GSAP, D3, or Framer Motion, or use Remotion for frame-based video.
Set up timestamp previews and provide a complete static view for reduced motion.
limitations: You supply the diagram structure, labels, or data values.
Single-file HTML examples that load libraries from a CDN need a network connection.
The skill does not include the screenshot helper scripts described in its instructions.
Rendering a video requires a separate Remotion project and rendering tools.

use_cases.title: Walk Through a Service Architecture
use_cases.description: Reveal each service and connection in order, then highlight the path of a request through the system.

use_cases.title: Present Quarterly Results
use_cases.description: Grow each bar from the baseline and show a formatted total that stops at the exact reported value.

use_cases.title: Time a Diagram to Narration
use_cases.description: Match each diagram reveal to a line of narration and preview specific frames in a Remotion composition.

prompt_templates.title: Reveal a Simple Process
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an offline HTML animation of Submit, Review, and Approve using SVG and CSS. Reveal the nodes, then their arrows, then their labels.
prompt_templates.scenario: Make a first animated flowchart without external libraries.

prompt_templates.title: Show Flow Direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Animate the supplied SVG so a dot travels from the intake node to the queue. Keep the full diagram visible when reduced motion is enabled.
prompt_templates.scenario: Add direction to an existing diagram.

prompt_templates.title: Animate a Data Chart
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my existing D3 project to animate these monthly totals. Grow each bar from zero, stagger the reveals, and keep the final labels exact.
prompt_templates.scenario: Add a data-driven reveal in an existing web project.

prompt_templates.title: Sync a Reveal to Video Frames
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a Remotion composition from the supplied diagram and narration cues. Match each reveal to its cue and identify frames for reviewing the reveal order.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a diagram sequence for a narrated video.

output_examples.input: Animate the Submit, Review, and Approve flow in one offline HTML file.
output_examples.output: The three nodes appear in order, followed by arrows and labels. Reduced motion shows the complete flow without animation.

output_examples.input: Animate a line chart for sales of 120, 150, and 180 units.
output_examples.output: The line draws from the first point to the last, and the final count settles at exactly 180 units.

output_examples.input: Reveal a client, queue, and worker in sync with three narration cues.
output_examples.output: A Remotion composition reveals each component at its cue. The preview frames show the opening layout, the first connection, and the completed diagram.

best_practices: Reveal nodes before their connectors and labels, and leave time for readers to follow each step.
Check the opening, midpoint, and final states for clipped labels, correct connector endpoints, and exact values.
Show the complete diagram and final values when reduced motion is enabled.
anti_patterns: Revealing every node and connector at once in a guided explanation.
Using continuous motion where it does not communicate direction or activity.
Relying on an unpinned CDN import for a diagram that needs to work offline.

faq.question: What kinds of diagrams can I animate?
faq.answer: The recipes cover flowcharts, service architecture diagrams, sequence diagrams, and connectors that show direction.

faq.question: Can I start with a Mermaid or Excalidraw diagram?
faq.answer: Export it to SVG first, then animate the individual nodes, connectors, and labels.

faq.question: Can the HTML work offline?
faq.answer: Yes, when all dependencies are local or embedded. The supplied GSAP CDN examples require network access.

faq.question: How can I check a specific moment?
faq.answer: Use the timestamp control for browser output, or select a specific frame in Remotion.

faq.question: Does the skill support reduced motion?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance replaces animated reveals and loops with the complete diagram and final chart values.

faq.question: Will it export a video by itself?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides Remotion recipes, but you still need a Remotion project and rendering tools.
